name: clawd-spinner
description: Clawd acts out the spinner's word above it while Claude works: cooking for Sautéing, dancing for Vibing, pacing for Pondering, a scene of its own for every one of the 189 spinner words. Uses none of your usage: everything is animated locally, no model calls.

place.title: Clawd's home
place.description: Where Clawd acts out: the band above the prompt (never taken away for text, fold with its [-]) or the spinner row beside the word (he stands down while text streams there).

size.title: Clawd's size
size.description: How much stage Clawd takes: large (the full 8-row act, his classic size), middle (6 rows, a smaller him) or small (4 rows, pocket-sized, speech on one bare line).
